jobs.title: Senior Customer Success Architect Full-time Senior Tel Aviv
jobs.description: Senior Customer Success Architect - Noma Security All jobs Senior Customer Success Architect Tel Aviv Full-time Senior Join Noma Security and help shape the future of AI security. Noma is building the first comprehensive AI Security and Governance Platform, helping organizations adopt AI, Agents and LLMs with confidence and control. As AI becomes core to modern enterprises, we provide seamless visibility and protection across the entire AI lifecycle—from development to production and autonomous agents. Our team works at the intersection of AI, security, and cloud, shaping a new category in a fast-evolving market. We’re looking for a Senior Customer Solutions Architect to own strategic post-sales relationships and help customers build and mature their AI Security and Governance programs. This role combines the technical and consultative strengths of a Solutions Engineer with long-term ownership of customer outcomes, adoption, and value realization. You’ll work with stakeholders ranging from security practitioners to CISOs, continuously discovering new use cases and helping customers understand where they are in their AI journey, where they need to go, and how Noma can help them get there. You’ll own the overall customer relationship and direction, partnering with Customer Operationalization Engineers and other technical resources on deployment, integrations, configuration, and troubleshooting. 🛠️ What You’ll Do Strategic Customer Leadership: Own post-sales relationships for a focused portfolio of enterprise customers, building trusted partnerships across technical practitioners, security leaders, and executives. Discovery & AI Security Advisory: Understand each customer’s AI environment, security program, priorities, and risks; identify new use cases and provide practical guidance on AI security and governance. Value & Adoption: Connect customer objectives to Noma’s capabilities, define measurable outcomes, drive adoption, and ensure customers realize and can articulate meaningful security and business value. Retention & Expansion: Partner with Sales on account strategy, identifying new stakeholders, workloads, teams, use cases, and business units where Noma can deliver additional value. Cross-functional Leadership: Coordinate Product, Research, Engineering, Security, Support, and Customer Operationalization resources while channeling customer insights back into Noma. ✅ What You Bring 5+ years of experience in customer-facing cybersecurity roles such as Solutions Engineering, Solutions Architecture, Customer Success Engineering, security consulting, or strategic technical account management. Strong cybersecurity expertise and a solid understanding of modern AI technologies and architectures, including generative AI, LLM applications, RAG, AI agents, AI development pipelines, and MCP. Ability to move comfortably between CISO-level strategy, GRC and risk discussions, business outcomes, and deep technical conversations. Proven ability to conduct discovery, build trusted enterprise relationships, define customer outcomes, and translate complex technology into practical solution strategies. Strong commercial awareness, intellectual curiosity, and experience identifying opportunities for increased adoption and customer growth. 🎯 Nice to Haves Experience with AI security, AI governance, or securing generative AI applications and autonomous agents. Familiarity with frameworks and standards such as NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, OWASP guidance, MITRE ATLAS, and emerging AI regulation. Experience working in a high-growth cybersecurity startup or across both pre-sales technical and post-sales customer-facing roles. 💙 Perks & Benefits Located in a prime area with easy access to public transportation, near the Hashalom train station and the Light Rail. A bright, spacious, dog-friendly office that makes you smile the moment you walk in 🐶 Team bonding activities, company retreats, happy hours, and holiday gifts Pilates classes at the office 💪🧘‍♀️ Never hungry: Monthly lunch budget, dinners provided, and a fully stocked kitchen 🍽️ A warm, supportive, and people-first company culture Pension & Keren Hishtalmut (advanced training fund) A global work environment with teams across Tel Aviv, the US, the Netherlands, and London Options that let you share in Noma’s growth and success Apply for this position
